answer: Require each identity to verify a unique postal address by mailed code, like an onyx seal beside a pearl marker on a ledge mailbox. One code backs only one identity, and the code must be returned within 14 days. One fake costs one real deliverable address, about 12 credits in postage plus waiting time; renting more addresses grows scarcer and pricier, and several codes to one building are flagged, so cost per fake rises steeply with farm size.
